evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and positions ownership as the superior good (self-enhancement).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Privileging perspective as the retained asset appeals to self-directed judgment (autonomy) and the craft-quality that makes it worth keeping (competence).

mints.name: OwnershipAsValueDistinction
mints.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to ownership of one's own capability or perspective as the value that matters, distinct from what is borrowed or commoditized?
